plain: To stir up strong feeling or unrest

webster.text: To stir violently; to move back and forth with a quick motion; to shake or move briskly; as, to agitate water in a vessel.

more.text: To disturb, or excite into tumult; as, to agitate the mind or passions.

example.quote: The prosecution of them, for this reason, will seldom fail to agitate the passions of the whole community, and to divide it into parties more or less friendly or inimical to the accused.
